scientific_integrity: The all-graph proof is symbolic and uses unique witnessing centers and relative elementary collapses. The executable verifies 8,597 finite instances, not the universal quantifier; no machine/externally certified proof is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple graphs without a four-cycle as a subgraph; no characterization of all graphs and no equivariant one-dimensional collapse after arbitrary triangle-edge removal. Independent mathematical validation not performed.
title: Equivariant simplicial collapse of closed-neighborhood complexes without four-cycles
